test_cases.job_description: Senior Software Engineer, 5+ years experience, Python, Django, AWS, Microservices, CI/CD
test_cases.resume: Alex Johnson, 5 years experience as Software Engineer. Expert in Python and Django. Built microservices on AWS. Implemented CI/CD pipelines. Led team of 3.
test_cases.ground_truth: Excellent match - candidate has exact required skills and experience level. Strong Python/Django background with AWS and CI/CD. Only missing nice-to-haves like K8s.

test_cases.job_description: Machine Learning Engineer, 3+ years, Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MLOps, Production ML
test_cases.resume: Sarah Chen, 6 years software engineering. Python expert. Some coursework in ML. No production ML experience. Strong in backend development.
test_cases.ground_truth: Weak match - candidate lacks core ML engineering skills despite strong Python background. Would need significant upskilling in ML frameworks and production deployment.

test_cases.job_description: Full Stack Developer, React, Node.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, 2+ years
test_cases.resume: Mike Rodriguez, 4 years full stack. React expert. Node.js and Express. TypeScript proficient. MongoDB and PostgreSQL. Built 5 production apps.
test_cases.ground_truth: Perfect match - candidate exceeds all requirements with extensive experience in exact tech stack. No significant gaps.

test_cases.job_description: DevOps Engineer, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD, 4+ years
test_cases.resume: Jessica Lee, 3 years DevOps. AWS certified. Docker and Kubernetes experience. Jenkins CI/CD. No Terraform. Python scripting.
test_cases.ground_truth: Good match - candidate has most core skills (AWS, K8s, Docker) but slightly under experience requirement and missing Terraform. Could learn Terraform quickly.

test_cases.job_description: Frontend Developer, React, TypeScript, CSS, UI/UX design, 3+ years
test_cases.resume: Tom Wilson, 2 years frontend. React and JavaScript. Some TypeScript. Strong CSS. No formal design training. Built several personal projects.
test_cases.ground_truth: Moderate match - candidate has technical skills but lacks experience requirement and design background. Personal projects show motivation but needs professional growth.

test_cases.job_description: Data Engineer, SQL, Python, Spark, Airflow, ETL, Data Warehousing, 5+ years
test_cases.resume: Emily Davis, 7 years data engineering. SQL expert. Python and PySpark. Built ETL pipelines. Experience with Airflow. Snowflake data warehouse.
test_cases.ground_truth: Excellent match - senior candidate with all required skills and extensive experience. Snowflake experience adds value beyond requirements.

test_cases.job_description: Junior Developer, JavaScript, basic React, Git, any backend language, 0-2 years
test_cases.resume: Chris Martin, recent CS graduate. JavaScript and React coursework. Built class projects. GitHub portfolio. Node.js basics. Eager to learn.
test_cases.ground_truth: Good match for junior role - candidate has educational foundation and technical basics. Portfolio shows practical skills. Fits junior expectations.

test_cases.job_description: Principal Engineer, Distributed Systems, Scalability, 10+ years, Team Leadership
test_cases.resume: David Kim, 8 years as senior engineer. Microservices architecture. Some leadership. No distributed systems specialization. Led 2 projects.
test_cases.ground_truth: Insufficient match - candidate lacks seniority level and specialized distributed systems experience required for principal role. Leadership experience is limited.

test_cases.job_description: Mobile Developer, React Native, iOS and Android, 3+ years, App Store launches
test_cases.resume: Lisa Anderson, 4 years mobile dev. React Native expert. Launched 3 iOS apps and 2 Android apps. App Store optimization. Push notifications.
test_cases.ground_truth: Excellent match - candidate has specific React Native expertise with proven track record of launches. Cross-platform experience exactly matches requirements.

test_cases.job_description: Cybersecurity Engineer, Penetration Testing, Security Audits, OWASP, 5+ years
test_cases.resume: James Wilson, 3 years software engineer. Some security awareness. No penetration testing. No security certifications. Python scripting.
test_cases.ground_truth: Poor match - candidate is software engineer without security specialization. Missing all core security skills and certifications. Would need career transition.
